text:
Predicates:
MusicPiece(x) ::: x is a music piece.
Composer(x, y) ::: y is a composer of x.
Wrote(y, x) ::: y wrote x.
Premiere(s, x) ::: s premiered x.
Orchestra(x) ::: x is an orchestra.
Leads(y, x) ::: y leads x.
Conducts(x, y) ::: x conducts y.
Premises:
MusicPiece(symphonyNo9) ::: Symphony No. 9 is a music piece.
Composer(beethoven, symphonyNo9) ::: Beethoven wrote Symphony No. 9.
Premiere(viennaMusicSociety, symphonyNo9) ::: Vienna Music Society premiered Symphony No. 9.
Orchestra(viennaMusicSociety) ::: Vienna Music Society is an orchestra.
Leads(beethoven, viennaMusicSociety) ::: Beethoven leads the Vienna Music Society.
Orchestra(x) → ∃y (Conducts(y, x)) ::: Orchestras are led by conductors.
Conclusion:
∃x (Premiere(x, symphonyNo9) ∧ Orchestra(x)) ::: Some orchestras premiered music pieces.
